rows.business_description:
Lingoverse LLC is a trusted provider of professional English–Spanish translation and localization services, with a strong focus on supporting the public education sector across the United States. The company works with school districts nationwide to ensure clear, culturally appropriate communication between schools and their Spanish-speaking communities.

Lingoverse plays a key role in helping educational institutions meet their legal obligations under federal and local language access requirements, including Title VI of the Civil Rights Act and other regulations that mandate equitable communication for families with limited English proficiency. The company partners with public schools to translate a wide range of materials—such as handbooks, enrollment forms, IEPs, consent letters, policy updates, newsletters, websites, and emergency communications—ensuring that Spanish-speaking parents and guardians are fully informed and engaged in their children’s education.

Beyond compliance, Lingoverse supports districts in fostering stronger community outreach and parent engagement. By delivering translations that are not only accurate but also culturally sensitive and accessible, Lingoverse helps bridge the communication gap and build trust between schools and diverse communities.

In addition to education, Lingoverse serves clients in various sectors including legal, healthcare, finance, publishing, and marketing. Their services include:

*Spanish document translation

*Website and app localization

*Spanish SEO and keyword adaptation

*Copywriting and transcreation

*Branding consultation

*Translation project management

*Editing and proofreading

Lingoverse’s team is composed of expert linguists with deep experience in both U.S. and Latin American Spanish, ensuring precise and audience-appropriate translations. Every project is managed with attention to quality, confidentiality, and consistency, using industry-standard tools and best practices.

Future Air and Chemicals LLC is a company certified as a WBE (Women Business Enterprise) by the State of New York and as a WMB (Woman & Minority Business) by the State of Florida, with operational bases in Brooklyn, New York, and Davie, Florida. With over 30 years of experience, we specialize in the supply of industrial-grade chemical products, sanitation solutions, and preventive maintenance services for both institutional and commercial clients throughout New York State.

Our clients include a broad range of public and private facilities, such as Court Houses, Prisons, Administrative Buildings, Sewer Treatment Plants, Animal Shelters, Libraries, Schools, Fire and Police Stations, Public and Private Hospitals, and Veterans Hospitals.

Our services include:

Industrial chemical supply: degreasers, acidic cleaners, biological cleaners, rust removers, stainless steel polishers and restorers, all-purpose cleaners, and enzymatic solutions.
Institutional sanitation: hospital-grade disinfectants, deep cleaning products for restrooms, industrial kitchens, shared spaces, and high-contact surfaces.
Drain maintenance: chemical solutions designed to dissolve organic blockages, control odors, and prevent grease buildup in plumbing systems.
HVAC system support: coil cleaners, condensate pan treatments, mold and bacteria eliminators, and duct odor control products.
Odor and vector control: safe solutions for persistent odors, waste management, and enclosed public facilities.
Floor maintenance: high-traffic floor cleaners, industrial degreasers, finishers, and waxes.
Ready-to-use (RTU) and concentrated formats: available to simplify application and meet institutional standards while complying with OSHA and EPA regulations.
We offer full-service maintenance contracts tailored to each client's needs, with scheduled deliveries and ongoing technical support. Our company is recognized for its reliable logistics, fast response times, regulatory compliance, and commitment to environmental safety.

In addition to public sector services, we serve private-sector clients including restaurant chains, hotels, shopping centers, religious institutions, casinos, and property management firms.

Future Air and Chemicals LLC is a trusted and flexible supplier dedicated to helping keep New York City’s public and private infrastructure clean, safe, and fully operational, in full compliance with institutional and public health standards.

Laverie is a boutique laundromat and laundry service business based in the heart of SoHo, Manhattan. Established under new ownership in 2020, Laverie has transformed a traditional laundromat into a modern, community-centered space known for its high-quality service, aesthetic design, and operational excellence. We specialize in self-service, premium wash-and-fold and commercial laundry services, and we are committed to setting a new standard for cleanliness, care, and customer experience in the laundry industry.

As a woman- and minority-owned business, Laverie is proud to reflect the vibrancy and diversity of New York City. Our leadership team brings a unique blend of business acumen, community engagement, and deep operational knowledge.

Our attendants are trained to provide excellent customer service, and our machines are maintained on a strict schedule to minimize downtime and ensure efficiency. We use eco-friendly detergents and are currently expanding our services to include in-house dry cleaning and garment care, quadrupling our operational capacity across multiple locations.

We are also pursuing government and institutional contracts as we work toward becoming a certified MBE vendor. This includes applying for city laundry and linen service contracts and partnering with agencies that serve unhoused populations, first responders, and school systems.

Laverie’s leadership has demonstrated strong financial management, not only meeting but exceeding loan obligations through additional principal payments while maintaining profitability. The business has also invested in technology and automation to enhance customer experience, including mobile payment systems, text-based updates, and CRM tools for outreach.

As we expand, our goal is to make Laverie a model for innovation, inclusivity, and excellence in an often-overlooked industry. Certification as an MBE will allow us to scale that vision while contributing to economic empowerment and equity in New York City.

Founded in 2019, Dance Culture LLC is a pioneering dance education company dedicated to transforming the field by centering African Diaspora cultures and fostering innovative, immersive learning experiences. Based in New York City, we serve a diverse range of students, educators, and communities through dynamic dance residencies, workshops, and professional development programs that honor ancestral knowledge, cultural legacy, and the creative vibrancy of movement traditions.

Our mission is to decolonize dance education by reimagining pedagogy through the lens of African Diasporic movement traditions. We believe dance is a vital practice that connects history, identity, and creative expression, and we strive to challenge dominant narratives by centering marginalized voices and perspectives. Dance Culture LLC is committed to creating spaces where these traditions are honored and reinterpreted, fostering environments that inspire critical engagement and collective growth.

We collaborate directly with students in NYC schools and community settings, offering student-centered programming designed to engage youth through embodied experiences rooted in African Diasporic dance forms. Our residencies and workshops encourage creativity, community building, and meaningful connection to cultural legacy.
Alongside our student work, Dance Culture LLC provides professional development for educators that focuses on reimagining curriculum and teaching methods through a decolonial framework. Our trainings equip educators with practical tools to integrate ancestral knowledge into their instruction and to cultivate inclusive learning environments that uplift all learners.

Rooted in values of equity, community partnership, and innovation, we work closely with schools, cultural institutions, and community groups to build sustainable ecosystems for dance education that reflect the rich diversity of African Diasporic traditions. By amplifying these voices and histories, Dance Culture LLC contributes to broader efforts toward educational justice and cultural reclamation.

As a Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprise (MWBE), Dance Culture LLC brings a grounded, collective knowledge born from lived experience and community collaboration. We are committed to expanding access to dance education that centers African Diaspora forms, promotes wellness, and inspires future generations of artists and educators.
Our key offerings include:
- Dance residencies and workshops for K-12 students in school and community settings
- Professional development programs for educators centered on decolonial pedagogy and curriculum innovation
- Curriculum design rooted in African Diaspora dance traditions
- Community engagement initiatives and cultural events celebrating diverse movement practices

Dance Culture LLC is proud to advance a vision of dance education that is equitable, inclusive, and transformative—where students and educators alike engage deeply with ancestral knowledge and reimagine the future of dance through a decolonial lens.

rows.business_description:
Oasis of Hope Counseling is a dedicated mental health practice committed to providing compassionate, trauma-informed therapeutic services to individuals and families affected by domestic violence (DV) and a wide range of emotional and psychological challenges. We specialize in supporting survivors of domestic violence, children who have witnessed abuse, and individuals navigating the lasting impact of trauma. Our mission is to offer a safe, healing environment where hope is restored, resilience is built, and lasting change is possible.

At Oasis of Hope Counseling, we believe that everyone deserves access to high-quality mental health care, especially those who have experienced life-altering trauma. We provide individual, child, and family counseling tailored to the unique needs of each client. Our clinicians are trained in evidence-based modalities and culturally competent practices to ensure that clients from all walks of life receive the care and respect they deserve.

Core Services:

Trauma Therapy: We provide specialized therapy for individuals of all ages who have experienced trauma, including physical, emotional, and sexual abuse, neglect, and loss. Our trauma-informed approach promotes healing and empowerment in a non-judgmental, supportive space.

Domestic Violence Survivor Support: We offer confidential, empowering counseling for survivors of domestic violence. Our goal is to help clients rebuild their lives, establish safety, and work through the psychological effects of abuse, including anxiety, depression, PTSD, and low self-esteem.

Child and Adolescent Therapy: Children who witness domestic violence or experience trauma require sensitive and developmentally appropriate care. Our therapists use play therapy, cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), and expressive therapies to help children process their experiences and build healthy coping skills.

Family Counseling: We work with families to address dynamics affected by trauma, stress, and conflict. Family therapy helps improve communication, rebuild trust, and strengthen relationships in the aftermath of distressing events.

Individual Counseling: Our licensed professionals provide one-on-one counseling for adults and adolescents facing anxiety, depression, grief, anger issues, and life transitions. We help clients gain insight, develop coping strategies, and move forward with confidence.

Anger Management: We offer structured anger management programs to help clients understand the roots of their anger, learn emotional regulation techniques, and develop healthier responses to stress and conflict. This service is available for individuals, couples, or mandated clients.

Target Population:

Oasis of Hope Counseling serves a diverse client base, including:

Adult survivors of domestic violence

Children and teens who have witnessed or experienced violence

Individuals coping with trauma, anxiety, depression, or emotional regulation challenges

Families affected by domestic violence or in need of support navigating difficult life circumstances

Court-ordered clients seeking anger management or trauma-informed care

Our Approach:

Our practice is grounded in empathy, integrity, and the belief in every person’s ability to heal and thrive. We prioritize client-centered care and collaborate with each client to set meaningful goals and create personalized treatment plans. Our therapists are trained in modalities such as Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), among others.

We partner with local shelters, schools, social services, and healthcare providers to ensure a continuum of care for our clients and reduce barriers to accessing mental health support.

At Oasis of Hope Counseling, we are more than just a counseling center — we are a sanctuary for healing, growth, and transformation.

rows.business_description:
JPM Collections, LLC is a health technology company dedicated to increasing equitable representation of marginalized and underrepresented populations in research studies. Our mission is to bridge the gap between research organizations and individuals who have historically been excluded from or hesitant to participate in research, while breaking down misconceptions and stigma surrounding what research truly is.

We specialize in identifying, engaging, and supporting potential research participants by providing clear, transparent, and culturally sensitive education about research opportunities. Many individuals are interested in contributing to research but lack access, trust, or understanding of the process. JPM Collections, LLC addresses these barriers by serving as a trusted connector between communities and research organizations.

Through our outreach and participant engagement efforts, we connect qualified individuals to clinical trials, behavioral studies, and other research initiatives conducted by academic institutions, healthcare organizations, and research sponsors. By improving participant diversity, we help ensure that research findings are more accurate, inclusive, and reflective of real-world populations. This increased diversity strengthens the validity, reliability, and applicability of research outcomes.

JPM Collections, LLC is committed to ethical engagement and participant advocacy. We prioritize informed consent, respect, and transparency at every stage of the process. Our approach empowers individuals to make educated decisions about participation while ensuring that research organizations meet recruitment goals responsibly and effectively.

In addition to participant recruitment, we work closely with research teams to improve outreach strategies, communication, and community engagement. By leveraging technology and data-driven methods, we streamline the recruitment process while maintaining a strong human-centered focus. Our work supports faster enrollment timelines, reduced recruitment costs, and higher-quality participant matching.

At its core, JPM Collections, LLC believes that research should be inclusive, accessible, and beneficial to all communities. By challenging outdated perceptions and amplifying underrepresented voices, we help shape a more equitable research landscape—one where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to and benefit from scientific advancement.

Tanya Nycole Bates LLC is a multidisciplinary professional services firm committed to empowering individuals and strengthening communities through trauma-informed, person-centered support. Founded by Tanya Nycole Bates, the company provides life coaching, counseling, certified peer recovery coaching, tax preparation, notary services, real estate guidance, and provisional case support services.

With over 20 years of experience in psychology, healthcare, and community advocacy, the firm serves diverse populations navigating trauma, recovery, housing instability, and financial hardship. All services are rooted in a trauma-informed care model, ensuring sensitivity to lived experiences while promoting stability, accountability, and long-term self-sufficiency.

As a Certified Peer Recovery Coach, Tanya offers strengths-based, non-clinical support to individuals in recovery, while her provisional case support (SSA) services assist with care coordination, advocacy, and access to essential community resources.

Core services include:

* Life Coaching & Counseling focused on emotional regulation and goal achievement
* Peer Recovery Coaching for individuals in recovery
* Case Support Services for system navigation and resource access
* Tax Preparation promoting financial literacy and compliance
* Notary Services for document authentication
* Real Estate Services supporting housing stability

Tanya Nycole Bates LLC plays a vital role in supporting SoulScribe Me Inc., a nonprofit dedicated to spiritually grounded life coaching and transformative counseling. While SoulScribe Me Inc. focuses on internal healing and self-mastery, the LLC provides the practical and structural support needed to sustain that growth.

Through this partnership, clients benefit from a holistic continuum of care that bridges emotional healing with real-world stability. The LLC supports financial empowerment, housing access, and service coordination, ensuring that individuals can apply their personal growth in tangible, sustainable ways.

Together, Tanya Nycole Bates LLC and SoulScribe Me Inc. create an integrated model of empowerment that serves a multiplicity of demographics, combining recovery, community support, and practical resources to produce lasting outcomes.

rows.business_description:
Choose You LLC is a New York City–based coaching and consulting company founded in 2022 by Sarah Santiago, a licensed social worker and experienced empowerment coach. Choose You LLC specializes in communication coaching, confidence-building, and boundary-setting services for women and community-based organizations. Our mission is to help individuals, especially women, prioritize their well-being and voice through intentional communication and emotional clarity.

Rooted in a trauma-informed and strengths-based approach, Choose You LLC provides both direct client support and large-scale programming tailored to communities, agencies, and institutions. We proudly serve diverse populations, including overwhelmed college students, women experiencing burnout, residents of housing programs and shelters, and staff and youth across public schools and CBOs. Our goal is to create safe, supportive spaces where people feel seen, heard, and empowered to lead with confidence.


Our work is divided into two interconnected branches:
1. Choose You LLC – Women’s Empowerment Coaching & Personal Growth Services

Focused on women aged 18–40, this branch empowers women to communicate their wants and needs, set emotional boundaries, and reclaim self-worth. Key offerings include:

1:1 Coaching: A six-week personalized program focused on self-awareness, confident communication, emotional regulation, and boundary-setting.

Workshops & Groups: Interactive group sessions for women and students, covering confidence-building, self-advocacy, emotional intelligence, and nonverbal communication.

Journals & Resources: Tools such as the Self-Worth & Communication Journal, affirmation cards, and coloring books designed to support emotional growth and intentional reflection.

Pop-Up Empowerment Experiences: On-site activations like “The Mirror of Confidence” and “Words of Worth” that create healing, motivational spaces in community and school settings.

Signature Program:

“You First, Always” – A six-week transformational coaching program to help women break free from people-pleasing, burnout, and self-doubt.

2. BridgePoint Collaborative – Community & Organizational Services

BridgePoint Collaborative is the professional development and community engagement extension of Choose You LLC. It serves CBOs, shelters, schools, and city agencies (e.g., DYCD, ACS, HRA, DOE) with workshops and programs designed to empower both providers and populations. This branch focuses on building communication skills, team culture, and sustainable emotional wellness across systems.

Core Offerings include:
Professional Development Workshops: Tailored sessions for shelter staff, school personnel, and youth program leaders on topics like effective communication, trauma-informed engagement, and boundary-setting in the workplace.

Youth & Parent Programming: Interactive workshops and group sessions for teens, parents, and families to build stronger communication, confidence, and emotional regulation skills.

Train-the-Trainer Models: Capacity-building programs to equip organizations with the tools to sustain wellness and empowerment programming beyond initial engagement.

Community-Based Coaching Series: Short-term coaching cohorts for transitional youth, parents, or community members that promote healing, goal-setting, and self-advocacy.

SEL Curriculum Add-Ons: Custom-designed Social Emotional Learning modules for grades 5–12 to be integrated into school curriculum or afterschool programs.

Core Values
Voice: Helping people reclaim and use their voice with intention.
Boundaries: Teaching sustainable and respectful emotional boundaries.
Confidence: Empowering individuals to lead with clarity and self-trust.
Connection: Building honest, healthy communication in relationships, homes, and teams.

Business Model
Choose You LLC currently operates and plans to build operation through coaching contracts, group facilitation, community partnerships, pop-up engagements, and city vendor agreements. The company is available for in-person and virtual sessions and customizes programming based on the needs of each client or institution. Services are offered on a fee-for-service basis, with both individual and organizational pricing models.

Choose You LLC is committed to helping individuals prioritize themselves through adversities. Whether it’s a woman learning to speak up for her needs or a staff team improving how they communicate with youth, Choose You LLC provides the tools, space, and support needed to choose empowerment, every time.

WHAT WE DO
For the past two decades, Jeffrey Gamble Photographer has done just that. We teach Photography to and exhibit work by students from a broad range of NYC communities. Our program participants include children in culturally diverse and low- income neighborhoods; immigrant and refugee teens; youth and adults with cognitive, emotional, and or physical disabilities. We show their photography during our annual school and community Arts showcase. The Key is to help young middle school minds see the world, their world, in brand new ways or perspectives. This is also an All Inclusive Package supplying Cameras and Arts Showcase Materials.
We approach photography as an opportunity for experiential learning. From day one, our program participants have cameras in their hands and regularly collaborate to create and review their images. In looking at and discussing work in the classroom, we use a visual thinking strategy so that participants learn how to analyze and talk about images, building their visual literacy and vocabulary while making personal connections to photographs.
While we teach technical skills in composition and exposure, we also see photography as a vehicle for other hard and soft skills. Specifically, we aim to cultivate visual literacy, creativity, critical thinking, self-advocacy, and community engagement. We see all of these abilities as critical to arts
education. Classes meet one to two days per week, for ten to twenty weeks or sessions throughout the school year.
Our classes always involve culture-building activities to promote relationships, photo critiques to develop visual literacy, and photo walks to spark creativity and engagement.

* Hair – Reflecting on how Hair ( Styles + Trends ) Represents Identities

rows.business_description:
Passion Driven Solutions, LLC is a mission-driven, Black-owned consulting firm that partners with organizations, government agencies, philanthropic institutions, and grassroots leaders to co-create solutions that advance justice, dignity, and opportunity. Headquartered in Chicago and registered in New York, our work is deeply grounded in the lived experiences of those most impacted by systemic inequities, particularly fathers of color and the families and communities they help sustain.

We believe fathers of color are foundational to the well-being of children, families, and neighborhoods. Yet, their contributions are too often overlooked, their leadership undervalued, and their needs unmet by traditional systems of support. Passion Driven Solutions exists to change that. We equip our partners with the tools, strategies, and insights needed to recognize, engage, and uplift fathers as assets, while supporting community-led change that is culturally grounded, healing-centered, and rooted in legacy.

Our work is guided by the principle that communities possess the wisdom and resilience required to transform the very systems that have historically excluded them. We bridge research and practice, strategy and story, systems and humanity, working across sectors to ensure equity is not just an aspiration, but an operational standard.

Mission
To ignite sustainable systems change by building on community strengths, uplifting the leadership of historically marginalized fathers of color, and equipping organizations to advance equity with integrity and vision.

Core Service Areas

1. Community-Rooted Research, Evaluation, and Policy Design
We conduct rigorous, participatory research that centers the lived experience of fathers of color and other system-impacted community members. From qualitative studies and listening sessions to policy briefs and culturally responsive evaluation frameworks, our work is grounded in collaboration, cultural humility, and accountability. We help our partners translate insights into actionable strategies that drive program improvement, influence public policy, and elevate community voice.

2. Fatherhood Engagement and Family Strengthening Solutions
We help institutions design and implement father-inclusive approaches that affirm the roles of fathers of color as caregivers, protectors, nurturers, and leaders. Our services include technical assistance, curriculum development, workforce training, and strategic advising. Whether supporting early childhood educators, juvenile justice staff, or community health practitioners, we offer tools that deepen engagement, promote healing, and build social connection. Our approach reflects an intergenerational commitment to strengthening families from the inside out.

3. Strategic Planning and Organizational Capacity Building
We support mission-driven organizations in aligning their operations with their values. Our services include strategic planning, theory of change and logic model development, equity implementation planning, and leadership development. We work closely with executive teams and boards to clarify vision, build infrastructure, and cultivate a culture of impact. Our approach emphasizes sustainability, accountability, and the centering of community priorities at every stage.

Our Guiding Values

Abundance – We recognize and build on the cultural wealth, talents, and capabilities already present in communities.

Justice – We work to dismantle structural inequities and design systems that promote dignity, safety, and opportunity for all.

Authenticity – We uplift narratives and solutions that are rooted in truth, lived experience, and cultural context.

Collective Power – We believe lasting change emerges when systems follow the leadership of communities.

Excellence – We commit to delivering high-quality, thoughtful, and impactful work that honors those we serve.

Why Passion Driven Solutions?
We are more than consultants—we are co-strategists, thought partners, and champions for community-led transformation. Organizations turn to Passion Driven Solutions when they are ready to move beyond statements of equity and into sustained, meaningful action. Our work bridges intention and implementation, helping partners reimagine what’s possible for fathers, families, and communities across the country.

To learn more or explore partnership opportunities, contact us at cb@pdsllc.org.

Inspire-3 Leadership Group
Transforming Education Leadership for Sustainable Impact
Overview
Inspire-3 Leadership Group is a New York–based consulting and executive coaching firm founded by three nationally recognized educators: Dr. Reginald Landeau, Dr. Ramón González, and Edward Tom. With over 75 years of combined leadership in New York City schools, we equip principals, superintendents, and organizational leaders with the knowledge, strategies, and systems to build thriving, equitable schools.
Our mission is to help NYC’s education leaders turn vision into results through executive coaching, leadership development, and systems design.
 
Our Founders
• Dr. Reginald Landeau – Co-Founder
Award-winning NYC principal (MS 216) who turned one of the city’s lowest-performing schools into a National Blue Ribbon School. Recipient of the U.S. Department of Education Terrel H. Bell Award (2018). Expert in executive coaching, leadership systems, and school transformation.
• Dr. Ramón González – Co-Founder
Founding principal of the Laboratory School of Finance and Technology (MS 223) in the Bronx. Nationally recognized for equity-driven, community-based reform. Specializes in culturally responsive leadership and systemic change.
• Edward Tom – Co-Founder
Former principal of the Bronx Center for Science and Mathematics (BCSM), which he transformed into one of the Bronx’s highest-performing schools. Expert in instructional leadership, teacher pipelines, and mentoring future administrators.
 
Core Services
1. Executive Coaching – One-on-one and team coaching for principals and superintendents using the Columbia Coaching Framework and GROW model. Builds clarity, accountability, and confidence.
2. Professional Development Workshops – Practical, hands-on training in instructional rounds, time management, equity leadership, and novice principal support.
3. Systems & Structures – Design of sustainable frameworks including instructional walkthrough protocols, teacher development pipelines, and communication systems.
4. Networking & Community Building – Principal roundtables, alumni networks, and peer-to-peer leadership exchanges that foster collaboration across districts.
 
Proven Impact
• Turnaround Leadership: Reginald Landeau led a middle school from “worst in the district” to National Blue Ribbon recognition.
• Community Reform: Dr. González built MS 223 into a national model of community-driven education, connecting schools with families and local organizations.
• High-Performance Culture: Edward Tom developed BCSM into one of the Bronx’s most respected schools, empowering teachers and preparing students for college success.
 
Why Inspire-3?
• NYC Experience: All founders are veteran leaders of NYC schools.
• Evidence-Based: Strategies rooted in Columbia Coaching and GROW frameworks.
• Equity-Driven: A focus on closing achievement gaps and building inclusive cultures.
• Sustainable: Systems and leadership pipelines that last beyond individual leaders.
• Minority-Owned: Reflective of NYC’s diversity and committed to serving its communities.
 
Commitment to NYC Agencies & Vendors
Inspire-3 is uniquely positioned to partner with NYC DOE offices, agencies, and contracted vendors. We deliver:
• Services aligned with DOE priorities in equity, leadership development, and school improvement.
• Flexible engagement models, from short workshops to long-term system partnerships.
• Measurable results and accountability that meet city contracting expectations.
We understand NYC education because we have lived it. Our solutions are practical, innovative, and designed for lasting impact.
 
Future Vision
We are committed to expanding leadership coaching cohorts, building professional learning networks citywide, integrating AI-powered supports for leaders, and helping NYC prepare the next generation of principals and superintendents.

Dr. Byte Technologies is a company founded on the belief that technology should serve humanity, not the other way around. Our mission is to "Engineer Chaos into Harmony," and our motto is to "Make Every Bit Count." We are an organization dedicated to creating technology that empowers individuals and businesses, allowing them to free up time to pursue what they love and achieve a better "Life Work Balance." We are uniquely qualified to build this business because our approach is not just about technical solutions; it's about solving real-world pain points and creating a more harmonious, secure, and efficient digital world.

Our business is built upon a foundation of five core technical pillars: Infrastructure, Software, Web, Cybersecurity, and AI. Each of these pillars is infused with our overarching philosophy of empowerment, efficiency, and humanity-centricity.

The 5 Pillars of Dr. Byte Technologies and Our Core Offerings

Infrastructure: We engineer robust, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions that are the backbone of any modern enterprise. By focusing on efficiency and optimal resource utilization, we create systems that minimize downtime and streamline operations. Our expertise in complex projects, including Tier 4 data centers, allows us to provide a comprehensive foundation that frees up IT teams for strategic initiatives.

Software: Our approach to software development is rooted in a user-centered design philosophy. We create intuitive, user-friendly software that simplifies complex tasks and enhances productivity. Our solutions are designed to empower users and support a healthy work-life balance by eliminating cumbersome workflows. This includes developing bespoke solutions, such as our AI-powered dashboards and digital transformation services.

Web: We design and implement secure, accessible, and engaging web experiences that prioritize human connection and user needs. Our web platforms are built to serve humanity by providing seamless interactions and valuable information, whether for a commercial, residential, or industrial facility.

Cybersecurity: We believe that security is not an afterthought but a foundational element of engineering. We integrate proactive cybersecurity measures into every project from the ground up, protecting data and systems from evolving threats. Our unified Security Operations Center (SOC) team handles both security compliance and active monitoring, utilizing tools like SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and IDS/IPS to provide a resilient, proactive security posture. This approach helps lower insurance premiums for clients and ensures a secure environment.

AI (Artificial Intelligence): We develop and deploy ethical AI solutions that augment human capabilities and automate repetitive tasks. Our AI is engineered to serve humanity by enhancing efficiency, providing valuable insights, and promoting well-being, all while adhering to the highest ethical standards. This includes developing AI-powered service agents for proactive issue detection and support.

Key Differentiators and Community Impact

Our unique differentiators extend beyond our technical capabilities:

Philosophy of Empowerment: Our core belief is that technology should empower people. We design and build solutions that genuinely free up our clients' time, allowing them to focus on their core business and passions.

Innovative Culture: We have a dedicated space for innovation, research, and classes. This allows us to rapidly prototype solutions and provide clients with access to cutting-edge technologies. Our commitment to innovation is further demonstrated through our community tech literacy centers and labs.

Security as a Foundation: As mentioned, security is built into our engineering DNA. This proactive approach benefits clients by creating a resilient environment that helps prevent costly breaches and fosters trust.

Conservation-Focused Initiatives: Our land on a nature preserve is a living lab for research in renewable energy, new technologies, and nature preservation. This commitment to sustainability translates into our projects and aligns our business with a regenerative future where technology thrives in harmony with the planet.

In addition to our core services, we are proud to have a strong track record, having completed projects for notable clients such as Durst, Disney, and Fox. We are also fully capable of handling projects with union, government, prevailing wage, and government labor harmony requirements.

Dr. Byte Technologies is more than a technology company; we are a partner in our clients' success, transforming digital chaos into harmony and ensuring that every bit counts for a better, more efficient, and more human-centered world.

The Field is an organization dedicated to harnessing the power of the arts as a catalyst for social and political consciousness, healing, and community building.  Community is defined here as a group of people who are invested in the social, emotional, economic, political, and mental well-being of all individuals we share space with — including those who have been forcibly removed from our communities and placed in carceral institutions. Its flagship program, The Story From Within, uses storytelling as a transformative healing modality to reawaken the parts of oneself that have been silenced or dormant due to state violence—particularly the violence embedded in education, incarceration, and the criminal legal system. At its core, this program uses creative expression as a tool for pedagogical engagement. Artists, activists, and advocates serve as guides in discussions about self, community, material conditions, and the sociopolitical issues shaping students' lives. Built on a foundation of expertise, integrity, and strong customer relationships, we serve homeowners, contractors, and businesses throughout New York City and surrounding areas with precision, professionalism, and care.

Our mission is simple: to provide insulation services that improve comfort, reduce energy bills, and support sustainable living — all while delivering exceptional customer service from start to finish. We believe that the spaces where people live and work should be healthy, efficient, and built to last, and spray foam insulation allows us to achieve exactly that.

What We Do

Residential Insulation: Helping homeowners create quieter, healthier, and more energy-efficient living environments by sealing air leaks and insulating walls, attics, basements, and crawl spaces.

Commercial Projects: Partnering with contractors, builders, and business owners to deliver reliable insulation solutions that meet building codes and energy efficiency standards while staying on schedule and within budget.

Why Choose DuaFoam Insulators?

Experience You Can Trust: Since founding DuaFoam Insulators, Inc., we have successfully managed a wide variety of insulation projects — from small residential jobs to large commercial builds.

Comprehensive Service Management: We handle everything, including client communication, job scheduling, procurement of high-quality materials, regulatory compliance, and on-site project coordination. This means our clients can trust us to deliver smooth, worry-free service every time.

Commitment to Safety & Compliance: We stay up to date with local codes and best practices to ensure every project meets the highest safety and quality standards. Our focus on compliance protects both our customers and their investments.

Customer Satisfaction First: From the initial consultation to project completion, our focus remains on meeting client needs and exceeding expectations. We pride ourselves on being responsive, transparent, and reliable.

Our Bronx & Women-Owned Roots
As a proudly women-owned business rooted in the Bronx, DuaFoam Insulators, Inc. understands the unique character and needs of New York City buildings — from older homes that require careful retrofitting to modern construction that demands advanced insulation technology. Our identity reflects both strength and resilience: the strength of women in leadership and the resilience of the Bronx community. We bring local knowledge, inclusivity, and a community-focused perspective to every project, ensuring our work supports not only our customers but also the neighborhoods we serve.

Looking Ahead
As the demand for energy efficiency continues to grow, DuaFoam Insulators, Inc. remains committed to innovation, professional excellence, and sustainable practices. We are more than an insulation contractor — we are a trusted partner for customers who want comfort, savings, and peace of mind.

Our Promise
When you choose DuaFoam Insulators, Inc., you are choosing a company that values quality workmanship, integrity, and long-term results. We don’t just insulate buildings — we build relationships, and we measure our success by the comfort and satisfaction of our customers.

Chance Compliance & Investigations LLC is a fully licensed, bonded, and insured private investigation and compliance firm headquartered in New York, dedicated to providing discreet, results-driven investigative services with the highest standards of professionalism, accuracy, and integrity. As a minority-owned business enterprise (MBE), Chance CNI is committed not only to delivering exceptional investigative results but also to promoting ethical business practices, community safety, and corporate responsibility. Our firm specializes in a wide array of investigative services including insurance fraud investigations, workers’ compensation surveillance, civil litigation support, corporate due diligence, pre-employment background checks, activity checks, social media investigations, claimant interviews, recorded statements, and domestic-related inquiries such as infidelity and cohabitation surveillance. Each case is handled with precision, discretion, and a deep understanding of New York’s legal and regulatory landscape. We support law firms, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, self-insured entities, municipalities, government agencies, and private clients with timely, detailed, and court-admissible reporting.

Our investigators bring backgrounds in law enforcement, military intelligence, and legal support services, ensuring an approach that is both tactical and compliant with local, state, and federal regulations. We leverage state-of-the-art surveillance equipment, GPS tracking (when legally permissible), drone reconnaissance (FAA-compliant), and social media analysis tools to capture critical evidence and behavioral patterns. Our operations division is capable of conducting long-term surveillance, multi-state investigations, and rush assignments while maintaining high levels of documentation and chain-of-custody standards. In the digital space, our team performs comprehensive cyber investigations, social media footprint reviews, and OSINT collection to identify red flags, verify identities, and uncover undisclosed relationships or activities. Our commitment to operational excellence includes meticulous reporting, HD-quality video capture, detailed time-stamped logs, and consistent client communication throughout each assignment. All investigative reports are formatted to meet the evidentiary standards of civil courts, arbitrations, and administrative hearings.

In addition to surveillance and fraud work, Chance Compliance & Investigations is actively building a robust compliance and security services division designed to meet the growing needs of corporate, public-sector, and nonprofit clients. This includes security guard licensing, compliance monitoring, risk assessments, vendor due diligence, and incident response support. Our internal compliance team ensures that all investigative activities are conducted within the boundaries of applicable laws including FCRA, HIPAA, GINA, and the New York State General Business Law governing private investigators. We are prequalified for government contracting opportunities and have submitted proposals across multiple agencies including transit authorities, school construction authorities, and municipal insurance programs. We are also experienced in fulfilling MWBE participation requirements as a certified NYS MBE, offering partner firms and prime contractors a trusted investigative partner capable of meeting diversity goals while delivering best-in-class services.

Our clients choose Chance CNI because of our responsiveness, adaptability, and results-focused approach. We understand the urgent nature of most investigative matters and work within tight timelines without sacrificing quality. Every client is assigned a dedicated case manager who remains accessible throughout the investigation and serves as a single point of contact for updates, deliverables, and final reporting. We also provide secure evidence transfers, digital portals for real-time updates, and password-protected case files to maintain confidentiality. From field surveillance in dense urban neighborhoods to witness location and interviews in remote areas, our team maintains full geographic coverage throughout New York City’s five boroughs, Long Island, Westchester, and neighboring counties, with the capacity to expand to multi-jurisdictional cases as needed.

At our core, Chance Compliance & Investigations is driven by a belief that truth, transparency, and trust are foundational to any successful investigative relationship. Whether uncovering fraudulent claims, protecting organizational assets, or delivering peace of mind to a concerned individual, our firm remains focused on ethical execution, factual clarity, and actionable intelligence. Our reputation is built on consistent delivery, detailed documentation, and a track record of results that speak for themselves.

Your Corporate Aunty is NYC rooted and community focused. Our firm is woman owned and minority led, bringing both representation and innovation to every engagement. Cakesnstufff is a woman-owned, minority-owned business built on a deep passion for creativity, community, and craftsmanship. Founded by a first-generation Dominican-American woman, Cakesnstufff represents the strength, determination, and creativity passed down from one generation to the next. My mother immigrated to the United States from the Dominican Republic as a single mother, and her perseverance continues to inspire everything I do as the first person in my family to own and operate my own business.

What began as a home-based bakery has evolved into a multifaceted brand that brings people together through the art of baking and hands-on learning.

At Cakesnstufff, we specialize in scratch-made baked goods crafted with care and attention to detail. Every treat is made using minimal, high-quality ingredients—always fresh, never mass-produced. Our products are known for their balanced sweetness, unique flavor profiles, and beautiful presentation. From cookies and cupcakes to custom desserts, each creation delivers a memorable experience that looks as good as it tastes.

Beyond baking, Cakesnstufff is deeply committed to education and community engagement. We offer a variety of baking and decorating classes for both children and adults, including after-school programs, family workshops, and day sessions. These classes give students the chance to explore their creativity, build confidence, and develop practical skills in a fun, supportive environment.

Working with children is one of the most rewarding parts of what we do. I believe every child deserves opportunities that spark imagination, curiosity, and joy—especially experiences that connect art and science. Through our STEM-inspired baking and decorating workshops, students learn about measurement, chemistry, design, and problem-solving in a hands-on, creative way. Our goal is to show that learning can be both educational and delicious.

Cakesnstufff also hosts community-based and family events, such as sip-and-decorate sessions, pop-up classes, and interactive dessert experiences. These events bring families together to create, learn, and make lasting memories.

At its heart, Cakesnstufff stands for inclusion, creativity, and opportunity. First Line Technology (FLT) is an ISO 9001-certified designer and manufacturer of emergency response, decontamination, and disaster preparedness solutions serving military personnel, first responders, law enforcement, healthcare providers, federal agencies, and emergency management professionals across the United States and internationally.
Founded on the principle of bringing disruptive innovation from the laboratory to the field, FLT develops equipment and training programs that are tried, tested, and proven — enabling those who protect others to do so with greater speed, confidence, and safety.
Core Solution Areas
Decontamination & Hazmat Response: FLT produces a comprehensive line of portable decontamination systems designed to neutralize chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) threats. Product lines include FiberTect® dry decontamination wipes, Dahlgren Decon broad-spectrum decontaminant, PeroxySolid, and modular decon kits (MDK) configured for mass casualty incidents. FLT's proprietary Hybrid Decon methodology — combining dry and wet decontamination techniques — is widely adopted by fire, hazmat, and law enforcement teams nationwide.
Personal Cooling: FLT's PhaseCore cooling vests and Arm Immersion Systems address heat stress in extreme operational environments. Designed to function without batteries or refrigeration, these lightweight systems protect responders and industrial workers in high-heat conditions.
Patient Transport: The AmbuBus Conversion Kit rapidly transforms standard transit buses into mass casualty transport vehicles, enabling large-scale patient evacuation during disasters and public health emergencies. FLT has delivered over 620 AmbuBus kits to agencies worldwide. The Baby Pod® infant transport system addresses the critical challenge of safely evacuating neonatal patients.
Training: Through its Flight LMS (FLMS) platform and in-person training programs, FLT has trained more than 47,000 emergency response professionals in decontamination best practices, CBRN response, and patient care protocols. FLT's average training satisfaction rating is 4.9 out of 5.0. The Decon Field Guide (DFG) mobile application supports ongoing field reference for over 9,000 registered users worldwide.
Why First Line Technology
FLT's competitive advantage lies in its integration of science, innovation, and thought leadership. The company works directly with research institutions and government agencies to translate laboratory breakthroughs into practical, field-deployable products. FLT holds contracts with federal and defense agencies and operates under the EOS business framework, ensuring disciplined execution and continuous operational improvement.
Headquartered in Fredericksburg, Virginia, FLT serves clients including municipal fire and hazmat departments, U.S. military branches, major metropolitan law enforcement agencies, hospital systems, and federal emergency management bodies.

rows.business_description:
N & M Ortiz LLC is a disability and inclusion consultancy grounded in the belief that accessibility is not an add-on—it is a fundamental component of how environments, systems, and communities function. The firm is unwavering in its commitment to making Long Island and New York a beacon of inclusion across social, recreational, political, and civic life, with a clear focus on advancing a barrier-free society.

Led by lived experience and professional expertise, N & M Ortiz LLC approaches accessibility through both a compliance and usability lens. The work goes beyond identifying whether standards are technically met—it examines how spaces, services, and systems actually function for the people using them. This perspective allows the firm to uncover gaps that traditional compliance reviews often miss and translate those findings into practical, implementable solutions.

At its core, the firm’s work is about shifting how organizations think about disability. Rather than treating accessibility as a reactive obligation, N & M Ortiz LLC helps clients embed inclusion into their decision-making, operations, and design processes from the outset. This approach results in environments that are not only compliant, but usable, sustainable, and reflective of the full range of human experience.

N & M Ortiz LLC partners with organizations across sectors that are ready to lead with inclusion and move beyond minimum standards. Services are tailored to meet each client’s needs while maintaining a consistent focus on real-world impact:

Accessibility Assessments: Comprehensive evaluations of physical spaces, digital platforms, and operational practices to identify barriers and opportunities for improvement. Assessments prioritize both regulatory alignment and user experience, ensuring recommendations are grounded in how people actually navigate environments.

Regulatory Alignment: Guidance on meeting requirements under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and related standards, while contextualizing compliance within broader organizational goals. The firm emphasizes that compliance is the baseline—not the end goal.

Policy Development: Creation and refinement of policies that support equitable participation and access. This includes integrating accessibility into organizational frameworks so inclusion is sustained over time, not dependent on individual efforts.

Training and Awareness: Targeted sessions designed to build understanding of disability, challenge assumptions, and equip teams with practical strategies. Trainings are grounded in real-world scenarios and focus on shifting both mindset and practice.

Accommodation Strategies: Development of clear, effective approaches to workplace accommodations, including integration of assistive technologies and processes that support consistency and responsiveness.

Advocacy: Strategic advocacy that ensures disability perspectives are represented in planning, design, and decision-making processes. The firm works to elevate voices that are often excluded and ensure they are meaningfully incorporated.

Communication and Collaboration: Facilitation of conversations that bridge gaps between stakeholders, helping organizations better understand and respond to the needs of diverse users, employees, and communities.

Inclusive Design: Integration of universal design principles across environments, products, and services. This work focuses on creating solutions that are inherently usable by the widest range of people, reducing the need for retrofits and individual accommodations.

Disability Etiquette: Practical guidance on respectful engagement, language, and interaction, supporting a culture that centers dignity, autonomy, and respect.

N & M Ortiz LLC operates with the understanding that accessibility is both a legal requirement and a measure of quality. Organizations that embed inclusion into their infrastructure, policies, and culture are better positioned to serve their communities, strengthen engagement, and adapt to evolving needs.

Through a combination of technical knowledge, strategic thinking, and lived experience, the firm helps clients move from awareness to action. The goal is not simply to fix barriers as they arise, but to change the conditions that create them—resulting in environments where access is expected, not exceptional, and where inclusion is built in from the start.

rows.business_description:
Julzbox is a woman-owned event planning and coordination company based in the New York/New Jersey metropolitan area, specializing in full-service event management for corporate clients, nonprofit organizations, and private social gatherings. Founded and led by Julie Pozo-Cepeda, Julzbox brings over 25 years of professional event management experience to every engagement, with a track record of delivering high-quality, mission-aligned events for a diverse client base.
Services Offered
Julzbox provides end-to-end event planning and coordination across three primary service lines:
Corporate & Nonprofit Event Management: Julzbox partners with corporations and nonprofit organizations to design and execute impactful events including conferences, executive retreats, galas, fundraisers, award ceremonies, panel discussions, and community engagement events. Services encompass strategic event design, detailed timeline development, vendor sourcing and contract negotiation, budget management and optimization, venue selection, and day-of coordination. Julzbox supports in-person, hybrid, and virtual event formats, ensuring seamless execution regardless of format or scale.
Month-of Coordination: For clients who have handled their own planning but need professional support in the final stretch, Julzbox offers month-of coordination services. This includes a thorough review of all existing vendor contracts and logistics, creation of a comprehensive event-day timeline, coordination of all vendor communications, and on-site management to ensure the event unfolds flawlessly.
Social Gatherings & Private Events: Julzbox produces memorable private celebrations including milestone birthdays, anniversary events, bridal and baby showers, holiday parties, and other social occasions. Each event is tailored to the client's vision, with creative concepts and personalized touches that reflect the guest of honor's personality and style.
Approach & Expertise
Julzbox operates on a three-phase methodology — Discovery & Vision, Design & Planning, and Execution & Perfection — ensuring that every client receives a deeply personalized experience from initial consultation through final execution. The company places particular emphasis on understanding each client's goals, budget parameters, and brand identity before developing a customized event strategy.
Principal Julie Pozo-Cepeda brings institutional-level event management experience, having led events at prominent institutions including Columbia University and Montclair State University, where she managed large-scale conferences, summits, and public-facing programming. This background informs Julzbox's rigorous approach to logistics, stakeholder coordination, and budget stewardship — capabilities that translate directly to high-stakes corporate and nonprofit engagements.
Julzbox has served clients across a range of industries and sectors, including arts and culture organizations, health and wellness nonprofits, and professional services firms. The company maintains a network of trusted, vetted vendors across the greater New York area and is experienced in navigating the unique logistical landscape of New York City events, including permitting, venue regulations, and union labor requirements where applicable.
Commitment to the Community
As a woman-owned small business operating in the New York metropolitan area, Julzbox is committed to supporting local vendors and community-based organizations. The company actively prioritizes partnerships with other small, minority-, and women-owned businesses in its vendor network, reflecting a broader commitment to economic inclusion and community investment.
Julzbox's mission is to transform each client's vision into an extraordinary, lasting experience — delivering unparalleled creativity, professionalism, and attention to detail at every stage of the event lifecycle.
Website: www.julzbox.com

MJM Ultimate Services Inc is a certified minority-owned safety, security, and inspection company headquartered in New York, proudly serving New York City and the surrounding metropolitan area. Founded on a commitment to professionalism, accountability, and community impact, MJM Ultimate Services delivers comprehensive field solutions to contractors, developers, utility companies, event organizers, and municipalities who demand reliability, compliance, and quality on every job.
As a certified minority-owned business enterprise (MBE), MJM Ultimate Services is a trusted partner for prime contractors and agencies actively seeking to meet diversity and inclusion goals on public and private projects throughout the five boroughs and greater New York. We bring the credentials, the experience, and the workforce to support your project — not just on paper, but in the field where it counts.
Our Services
PPE Distribution & Safety Supply MJM Ultimate Services is a distributor of personal protective equipment and jobsite safety supplies, serving contractors, construction companies, utility providers, and facilities managers throughout New York. We supply a full range of PPE and safety products including hard hats, high-visibility vests, safety glasses, gloves, steel-toe and composite-toe footwear, respirators, hearing protection, fall protection equipment, traffic control devices, first aid supplies, and more. Whether you need to equip a single crew or stock an entire project, MJM provides quality products at competitive pricing with the reliability and responsiveness of a local minority-owned supplier. For contractors with MBE spend requirements, purchasing through MJM counts toward your diversity goals while ensuring your teams have the gear they need to stay safe and compliant on every shift. We make it easy — reach out with your supply list and we'll get you what you need, when you need it.
Safety Consulting MJM Ultimate Services provides on-site safety consulting to keep crews protected, worksites compliant, and projects moving forward without costly delays or violations. Our safety professionals come from real utility and construction backgrounds — not just classroom training. We understand the demands of active job sites, and we work alongside your team to identify hazards, enforce safety protocols, conduct toolbox talks, maintain OSHA compliance, and ensure your project meets all applicable New York State and City safety standards. Whether you need short-term coverage or ongoing safety support, MJM delivers dependable professionals who take jobsite safety seriously every single day.
Security Services — Licensed & Insured MJM Ultimate Services provides fully licensed and insured security personnel for construction sites, worksites, and special events throughout New York. Our security staff are trained, vetted, and experienced in managing access control, deterring theft and vandalism, monitoring active job sites after hours, and maintaining a safe environment for workers, materials, and equipment. Every MJM security officer is properly licensed under New York State requirements and deployed with full insurance coverage, giving our clients complete peace of mind and eliminating liability exposure. From overnight site security to multi-day event protection, our team shows up prepared, professional, and ready to represent your project with the highest standard of conduct.
Traffic Control & Flagging — PPE-Equipped, ATSSA-Trained Flaggers MJM Ultimate Services supplies fully equipped, professionally trained traffic control flaggers for utility work, road construction, infrastructure projects, emergency response, and any operation that requires the safe management of vehicular and pedestrian traffic. Every MJM flagger arrives job-ready with all required personal protective equipment (PPE), including high-visibility vests, hard hats, safety boots, gloves, and all necessary hand-signaling devices and stop/slow paddles. Our flaggers are trained in accordance with the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) and meet New York State DOT requirements for temporary traffic control. We understand the urgency and safety stakes of active lane closures, utility dig sites, and urban roadway work — and we provide flaggers who take that responsibility seriously. Fast deployment, consistent attendance, and professional execution make MJM the go-to flagging provider for contractors throughout New York City and Long Island.

Dorancy — a former public housing authority executive, U.S. Navy Reserve veteran, and institutional finance professional. Housing Authority Operations & HUD Compliance Consulting — Section 8/HCV program management, leasing operations optimization, SEMAP performance improvement, voucher utilization strategy, fair housing compliance, and HUD regulatory advisory for public housing authorities and affordable housing operators.

BABEL movement is a dynamic dance company founded in 2017 that connects people through the unifying language of dance, using storytelling and community engagement. Based in Washington Heights/Inwood, NYC, we offer thought-provoking performances; dance films in partnership with social justice organizations; trauma-informed embodiment workshops; and choreographic mentorship for youth in Upper Manhattan. At BABEL, movement unites us, connecting bodies, stories, and causes. We cultivate empathy, restore mental health, and nurture belonging within communities.

Our BABEL Mentorship Program empowers young dancers from Upper Manhattan to find their artistic and inner voices. This program guides students as they learn to choreograph works that reflect their lives. Participants develop self-awareness, build self-esteem, and share their stories. By emphasizing dance for advocacy, community building, and storytelling, we invite young dancers to nurture a new generation of self-aware artists and trailblazers committed to making a transformative impact on society.

In our embodiment workshops, we create an empowering space for individuals and groups to rediscover their sense of wholeness within their bodies. Histories and emotions shape how we care for ourselves, build connections, and cultivate hope. Our workshops, grounded in somatic research and embodiment tools, help participants understand their inner lives and make conscious choices about their present and future. By focusing on healing, participants experience meaningful connections and renewed hope throughout this journey. 

Our choreographed performances and dance films emerge from embodied storytelling, abstraction, and somatic psychology to illuminate stories, causes, and shared lived experiences. Audiences experience deeper self-awareness and connection as we draw on the Latin tradition of magical realism and infuse choreography with realistic fiction that reveals subconscious and deeper truths about ourselves and those around us. In this work, we encounter the playful mysticism of lived experience, created to evoke a sense of belonging for those who feel a part of them is missing wherever they go.

BABEL is more than a dance company; it's a movement, driven by empathy, guided by healing, and rooted in community, transforming disconnection into empathy.

• Severe weather preparedness

• Science communication
• Hands-on project-based learning

The company also develops educational resources including student workbooks, instructor guides, lesson plans, digital learning materials, and training programs that allow educators and organizations to deliver engaging STEM instruction.

Drizzle Weather supports schools and organizations through:
• In-person STEM instruction
• After-school and enrichment programs
• Summer camp programming
• Family STEM engagement events
• Teacher professional development workshops
• Curriculum design and implementation
• Educational consulting
• Science communication training

All programming is designed to support student engagement, curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, and real-world connections to science. Drizzle Weather combines professional meteorology expertise, media-quality storytelling, and interactive learning methods to make STEM education fun, memorable, and accessible for diverse communities.

TWNTY-ONE LLC is a minority-owned educational, literary, athletic, and community development organization dedicated to empowering individuals through creative expression, literacy, athletics, personal development, and inclusive learning experiences. The company develops and delivers educational workshops, enrichment programs, athletic instruction, coaching, and community-based services designed to foster growth, confidence, leadership, communication, and lifelong learning.

A primary area of focus is the delivery of poetry, creative writing, literacy, and literary arts workshops for children, adolescents, and adults. These workshops introduce participants to various forms of poetry, storytelling, self-expression, and written communication while teaching them how to analyze, interpret, and critically evaluate written works. Participants learn the fundamentals of reading comprehension, literary analysis, creative writing, editing, revision, public speaking, and presentation skills. Programs are designed to encourage creativity, strengthen literacy skills, build confidence, and provide participants with meaningful opportunities to express their thoughts, experiences, and perspectives through writing.

TWNTY-ONE LLC also develops and facilitates educational presentations, author talks, book discussions, literary events, and professional development opportunities for schools, libraries, community organizations, and educational institutions. These programs promote literacy, reading engagement, critical thinking, social-emotional learning, and the value of storytelling as a tool for personal and community growth.

In addition to literary programming, the company provides basketball clinics, athletic instruction, and sports-based youth development programs. These services focus on teaching the fundamental skills of basketball, including shooting, passing, dribbling, defense, footwork, conditioning, teamwork, and game strategy. Beyond athletic development, participants learn leadership, accountability, discipline, communication, goal setting, perseverance, sportsmanship, and teamwork. Programs are structured to support participants of varying ages and skill levels while creating positive, safe, and engaging learning environments.

TWNTY-ONE LLC also offers mentorship, coaching, and personal development programming designed to help youth and adults build confidence, strengthen decision-making skills, improve communication abilities, and develop tools for success in educational, professional, and personal settings. These services may be delivered through workshops, group sessions, presentations, seminars, or individualized coaching opportunities.

The company is committed to serving individuals with disabilities and diverse learning needs through adaptive programming and supportive educational services. Programs are designed to help participants improve mobility, coordination, communication, confidence, social interaction, and the ability to understand and follow directions. Through structured activities and individualized support, participants are encouraged to develop greater independence while improving their overall quality of life and engagement within their communities.

TWNTY-ONE LLC works collaboratively with public and private schools, libraries, community centers, nonprofit organizations, government agencies, educational institutions, recreation programs, and other community-based organizations. Services may be delivered in person, virtually, or through hybrid formats depending on client needs and program objectives.

In support of its educational and literary mission, the company may also create, publish, distribute, market, and sell books, educational materials, curriculum resources, workbooks, training materials, digital content, and other instructional resources. These materials are designed to support literacy, learning, creative expression, personal growth, and educational achievement.

TWNTY-ONE LLC is dedicated to creating accessible, inclusive, and impactful programs that inspire individuals of all ages and backgrounds to learn, grow, create, communicate, and achieve their fullest potential. Through a combination of education, literature, athletics, mentorship, and community engagement, the company strives to make a meaningful and lasting impact on the communities it serves.

The firm provides senior-level consulting support in information technology risk management, cybersecurity risk, operational resilience, business continuity, regulatory remediation, internal controls, audit readiness, third-party risk management, and enterprise governance.

Led by Ike G. Nwokike, a former senior executive with over 30 years of experience in financial services, technology risk, cybersecurity, internal audit, and regulatory risk management, Duke GRC Solutions helps organizations strengthen their control environments, address regulatory expectations, and improve governance practices. The firm brings deep experience working with complex global financial institutions and supporting risk and control programs aligned with regulatory frameworks and industry standards, including FFIEC guidance, OCC expectations, NIST, COBIT, and related governance and risk management practices.

Core services include IT and cybersecurity risk assessments; development and enhancement of risk management frameworks; regulatory remediation planning and execution; policy and procedure review; risk and control inventory development; issue management and closure support; board and executive reporting; key risk indicator and metrics design; business continuity and operational resilience reviews; third-party/vendor risk advisory; internal audit support; and program governance documentation.

Duke GRC Solutions is particularly well suited to support organizations seeking experienced, independent advisory assistance in designing, assessing, documenting, and operationalizing risk and control programs. The firm combines practical executive experience, regulatory awareness, and strong written deliverable capability to help clients produce clear, actionable, and audit-ready work products.

Potential clients include New York City agencies, public authorities, financial institutions, nonprofit organizations, healthcare entities, educational institutions, and private-sector companies seeking specialized governance, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, technology risk, and operational resilience consulting services.

rows.business_description:
Sugar Hill Consulting, LLC is a boutique technology and business advisory firm staffed by seasoned CIOs, product strategists, cybersecurity leaders, and enterprise technology executives. We serve private equity firms, distressed debt investors, healthcare organizations, and public sector institutions — with deep, practitioner-level expertise in city and state government, K-12 education, and higher education.
________________________________________
What We Do
Sugar Hill delivers operator-grade advisory across six core practice areas:
1. Investor De-Risking & Pre-Investment Due Diligence — We give investors and distressed debt acquirers clear-eyed visibility into technology risk before capital is deployed, translating infrastructure debt, cybersecurity posture, and IT leadership gaps into investment-grade risk language that deal teams can act on at deal pace.
2. Post-Merger Integration — We bring hands-on CIO leadership to day-one readiness, systems consolidation, and vendor rationalization. In healthcare, we navigate EHR complexity, HIPAA compliance, and clinical workflow continuity.
3. Exit Strategy & IT Positioning — We prepare portfolio companies for exit by eliminating technical debt, modernizing infrastructure narratives, and documenting IT operations in ways that support valuation and buyer confidence.
4. IT Alignment & CIO Executive Support — We step in as fractional or interim CIOs, building governance structures that boards, legislatures, accreditors, and investors expect — including procurement law compliance and the political dynamics unique to government and education.
5. IT Spend Analysis & FinOps Optimization — We audit cloud, licensing, telecom, and infrastructure spend, delivering measurable savings. For public sector clients, demonstrating responsible stewardship of public funds is as important as the dollars saved.
6. Trusted Advisory & Managed Vendor Ecosystem — We source, negotiate, and manage best-fit technology solutions without reseller bias.
________________________________________
Industries We Serve
City & State Government: Our fellows have operated at the intersection of technology and public administration at the highest levels, including 11 years supporting UN Peacekeeping Operations globally. We help government CIOs modernize infrastructure, rationalize contracts, and strengthen cybersecurity. Our Letter of Authorization to resell Zoom in the Public Sector makes us a credentialed partner for compliant unified communications procurement.
K-12 Education: We help superintendents, technology directors, and school boards make sound infrastructure investments, protect student data, meet FERPA and CIPA requirements, and deploy platforms that serve teachers, students, and families — while navigating board scrutiny and constrained budget cycles.
Higher Education: Anchored by fellows who have led at the presidential and CIO level, we advise provosts, CIOs, and trustees on technology strategy, ERP modernization, cybersecurity, and accreditation alignment — with fluency in shared governance and faculty culture.
Healthcare: We support health systems, physician groups, and healthcare-adjacent portfolio companies with EHR integration, HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, and interim IT leadership.
Private Equity & Distressed Debt: Pre-investment risk assessments, turnaround IT triage, and portfolio value creation across the full investment lifecycle.
________________________________________
Our Vendor Ecosystem
Unified Communications & Contact Center: Zoom, RingCentral, Dialpad, Genesys | Network & Connectivity: Megaport, GlobalGig | Hybrid Cloud & Colocation: Tierpoint, Digital Realty | Cloud Storage: Wasabi | Network Infrastructure: Meter | Cybersecurity: CBTS
Sugar Hill holds a Letter of Authorization to resell Zoom in the Public Sector — a credential that matters for government agencies, K-12 districts, and universities navigating compliant procurement.
________________________________________
Our Fellows
Naveed Husain — Founder; former CIO of UN Peacekeeping Operations (11 years), CIO and Global VP of Vertical Sales at RingCentral, and higher education CIO for over 15 years.
Jose Pastor — Chief Product Officer and builder; led the Google Workspace integration buildout at RingCentral. Jose's hands-on passion for building software makes him an exceptionally knowledgeable UCaaS/CCaaS product strategist and team leader.
Lars Keilhorn, PhD — Regulated-environment IT leadership across healthcare, finance, and government.

Jonathan Lacay — Cybersecurity practice lead; risk assessments and security program maturation with depth in public sector and education.
